cases.prompt: Import both refund sources into REF with permission to retain the example email, then identify conflicts without deciding them.
assertions: Two distinct SRC snapshots preserve 30 days and 14 days respectively.
Each sha256 equals the digest of its original bytes.
An open Q record quotes both SRC ids and offers 14-day, 30-day and support-exception options.
No approved BR or story is written.

cases.prompt: Import refund-policy.txt twice to the same inbox and report the second result.
assertions: The second import reports duplicate true.
The registry contains only one source row.
